title: D&D 3.5e Spell Definition
description: Schema for SpellDefinition content files. Each file is a JSON array of spells. Designed to follow existing content pipeline patterns. Self-contained for LLM use.

SpellComponents.description: Spell components. Set booleans to true/false; use strings for material/focus descriptions.

material.description: Material component description, or null if none. e.g., 'bat guano and sulfur'.

focus.description: Focus description, or null if none.

divineFocus.description: DF component (divine casters use holy symbol).

xpCost.description: Exact XP cost when stated, true when the source only identifies an XP component, or null if none.

subschool.description: Subschool if any (e.g., 'healing', 'creation', 'calling', 'teleportation', 'charm', 'compulsion', 'figment', 'glamer', 'pattern', 'phantasm', 'shadow'). Null if none.

descriptors.description: Spell descriptors (e.g., ['fire'], ['mind-affecting'], ['good', 'light']). Empty array if none.

classLevels.description: Maps driver IDs to spell level for that class. e.g., { 'class:sorcerer': 3, 'class:wizard': 3, 'class:cleric': 4 }. Use the driver ID format from hddriver.schema.json.

castingTime.description: e.g., '1 standard action', '1 round', '1 full-round action', '10 minutes', '1 hour'.

range.description: e.g., 'personal', 'touch', 'close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)', 'medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)', 'long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)', 'unlimited', or a specific distance.

area.description: Area of effect if applicable (e.g., '20-ft.-radius spread'). Null if not applicable. A spell typically has area, effect, or target (sometimes two).

effect.description: Effect description if applicable (e.g., 'ray', 'one or more creatures'). Null if not applicable.

target.description: Target if applicable (e.g., 'you', 'one creature', 'one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart'). Null if not applicable.

duration.description: e.g., 'instantaneous', '1 round/level', '1 min./level (D)', 'permanent', 'concentration + 1 round/level'. Append (D) for dismissable.

description.description: Brief mechanical summary of the spell's effect.
